title: Use Display Only for visual confirmation without data transfer

statement.en: Use a Display Only request when the requester needs to visually confirm identity without receiving customer data.
statement.ja: requesterがcustomer dataを受け取らずにidentityを目視確認する場合はDisplay Only requestを使う。

conditions: Show identity data and the customer portrait within system-provided UI on the requester’s iPhone.
The customer data remains in the system UI and is not transmitted to the app.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable ID Verifier experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるID Verifierの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

title: Let the requester report a Display Only match result

statement.en: In a Display Only request, let the requester report whether the displayed identity matches the customer.
statement.ja: Display Only requestでは、表示されたidentityがcustomerと一致するかrequesterが報告できるようにする。

conditions: The app receives an approved or rejected result after the requester visually compares the portrait.
exceptions: Labels such as Matches Person and Doesn’t Match Person are examples, not required wording.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable ID Verifier experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるID Verifierの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。
